request.initial_prompt: After the encounter at Vyázma, where Kutúzov had been unable to hold back his troops in their anxiety to overwhelm and cut off the enemy and so on, the farther movement of the fleeing French, and of the Russians who pursued them, continued as far as Krásnoe without a battle. The flight was so rapid that the Russian army pursuing the French could not keep up with them; cavalry and artillery horses broke down, and the information received of the movements of the French was never reliable.
request.hotwords: After, Vyázma, Kutúzov, French, Russians, Krásnoe, Russian

raw_segments.text: After the encounter at Vyázma, where Kutúzov had been unable to hold back his troops in their
anxiety to overwhelm and cut off the enemy and so on, the farther movement of the fleeing
French and of the Russians who pursued them, continued as far as Krásnoe without a battle.
The flight was so rapid that the Russian army pursuing the French could not keep up with them,
cavalry and artillery horses broke down, and the information received of the
movements of the French was never reliable.
